meta.rule: Open-market purchases (Form 4, transaction code P) by 3 or more distinct insiders in the last 30 days totalling $500,000 or more.
caveats: Scope: the ranked names, lens candidates and terminal_watch.txt only, not the whole universe, to stay inside the SEC call budget.
Route: the SEC submissions API per company (one call each) plus each new Form 4 XML once; parsed filings are cached in out/cache/form4.json.
